text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Can she really be this strong?!
Is she truly this powerful?!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Duramente takes 1st place!
Duramente finishes in 1st place!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (I see, so you lost...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... Trainer-san.
I... can't do this anymore... Not against that girl...

text_block_list.name: Trainer A
text_block_list.text: I understand. ...Let's focus on your best distance this year. That way, your racing paths won't cross.

A cry bordering on anguish echoed through the underground path.
Listless footsteps scattered sparsely away.

That was just how shocking it was.
—Duramente's running, that is.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even though we checked everything.
What race developments she excels at,
and exactly how many seconds her final spurt lasts.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: And yet, Duramente back then—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHHHH!!

"I remember.
Even if she looked like a completely flawless adult,
she was still—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Trainer... ngh, —... I...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ――……I want to win.
—Those eyes were burning with resolve.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There's still a month until the Derby.
—A whole month left.
choice_data_list: ...Should we come up with a strategy against Duramente?
...Should we come up with a strategy against Duramente?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Let's get moving right away.
The more time we have to prepare, the better."
—She was...

—She does not tremble
before the looming shadow.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I will retrain myself.
I will not repeat a defeat like today's.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...True to your word, you will surely carry out that declaration."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Even so, I am stronger than you.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Flowing through my veins is the blood of my clan.
Blood that must be "the strongest."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, I won't lose.
With no hesitation in her eyes, Satono Crown stepped forward toward the Japanese Derby.
